video_title: What do the Cavs NEED TO DO to take Game 3? 👀 Windy breaks it down... | NBA Today

quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' historic scoring differential in 9-game win streak
quotes.excerpt: During their nine-game winning streak, they've outscored opponents by 212 points.
quotes.quote: MSG has been rocking this postseason. The Knicks, they haven't given the New York faithful a lot of reason to slow down here, right? During their nine-game winning streak, they've outscored opponents by 212 points. It's the most in any nine-game stretch in NBA postseason history.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers need offense and shooting to win Game 3
quotes.excerpt: Their defense isn't good enough to win a game that's in the 90s or the low 100s.
quotes.quote: They need some offense. They need some shooting. They're shooting about 30% from three points in this series. And look, I understand that you should be able to survive a bad shooting night, but the reality is they can't. Their defense isn't good enough to win a game that's in the 90s or the low 100s. They need to get up into the 100 teens, ideally the 120s. And I know everybody's all focused on Harden versus Brunson, and I agree. It hasn't looked great defensively, but Harden, the bargain with Harden is what he can do at the other end. He's got to start living up to that at the balance at the other end.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on using criticism to fuel an 0-2 comeback
quotes.excerpt: If you give a damn, if you're trying to really get somewhere, if you got personal pride, then come with it.

text_blocks.text: Perk, you've been down 0-2 a couple of times in your career. So what are the conversations that are happening in the Cavaliers locker room right now?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Well, you got to have the conversation in your head and in your heart. You got to care first. We was down 0-2 against San Antonio Spurs 2012, and I remember I was getting cooked in the pick and roll by Tony Parker and Ginobili. We was in the drop coverage. And I used to always go back home and watch the games when we land because I wanted to hear what was said about me. At the time it was Steve Kerr who was doing the play-by-play analyst, and I remember him saying, 'Oh, they need to bench Perk and go small with Serge Ibaka and switch all the pick and rolls.' The junk pissed me off. I took it personal. We came out, we switched in Game 3, I locked up Tony Parker and Ginobili on the switch in the first quarter, and then I looked over there and Steve Kerr in the timeout and was talking noise to him and Reggie Miller, and he said they was talking about it because that's what's supposed to fuel you. If you give a damn, if you're trying to really get somewhere, if you got personal pride, then come with it. That's where it starts. I ain't got no blueprint for them. Act like you care first.
